description: Our democracy is under attack and it goes beyond Trump and MAGA. For over two decades, Republicans have been chipping away at our democracy: flooding our system with money, stacking the Supreme Court with partisans, and breaking every norm in the book. Democrats have been weak in their response to this ongoing crisis. Scott will respond to these attacks with bold action that they demand.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Scott Wiener for Congress
title: Scott Wiener for Congress: Defending Democracy
